notes: This site uses FlexMLS IDX integration which loads property listings dynamically via JavaScript/iframe. The static HTML does not contain listing data. REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer). The listings appear to be embedded from link.flexmls.com. Business Opportunity listings are available at: https://houseofrealty.com/search/?url=https%3A%2F%2Flink.flexmls.com%2F1o97bdnkg1fi%2C10%26propertytype%3DD. The site uses the Houzez WordPress theme. To scrape this effectively, you would need to: 1) Use a headless browser to render JavaScript, 2) Wait for the FlexMLS iframe/widget to load, 3) Extract data from the rendered content, or 4) Consider accessing the FlexMLS API directly if available.
